title: Warm Hearty British Sausages Bangers And Mash
description: A classic Northern Irish dish featuring sausages and mashed potatoes, this recipe is a hearty and comforting meal for any time of day. The use of baby new potatoes and pressure cooking ensures a quick and delicious meal.
instructions: Peel and chop the baby new potatoes into large chunks and set them aside.
In a large pot, combine the chopped potatoes and enough cold water to cover them, then bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer the potatoes for 5 minutes, then drain the water and set the potatoes aside.
In a large skillet, cook the British sausages over medium-high heat, browning them on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the sausages from the skillet and set them aside on a plate, then add the unsalted butter to the skillet and let it melt.
Add the flour to the skillet and whisk it into the butter to make a roux, cooking for 1 minute.
Gradually add the chicken broth and milk to the skillet, whisking constantly to avoid lumps, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and let the gravy simmer for 2-3 minutes, then season it with salt and black pepper.
Add the cooked potatoes to the skillet and mash them into the gravy using a potato masher or a fork until they are mostly smooth.
Return the sausages to the skillet and let them simmer in the mashed potatoes and gravy for 2-3 minutes to heat through.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
